description: Python client library for the Sangfor Cloud Platform (SCP) Open-API: virtual machines, networks, images, volumes, elastic IPs, tasks, alarms and metrics, with EC2 (AWS4-HMAC-SHA256) and token authentication. Ships the scp-health CLI, a read-only platform health report.
rules: Create one SCPClient and use its resource attributes (client.servers, client.networks, client.tasks, ...); do not call the HTTP API directly.
Write operations are asynchronous: pass the returned task_id to client.tasks.wait(task_id, timeout=...) before using the result.
Use list_all(**filters) to iterate every page; list_page() returns a single raw page.
az_id means an SCP resource pool; IDs are UUID strings and results are plain dicts.
Token authentication (username/password) needs the token-auth extra: pip install "sangfor-scp[token-auth]".
Catch sangfor_scp exceptions (SCPError and subclasses such as SCPNotFoundError, SCPTaskError, SCPTimeoutError) instead of checking HTTP status codes.
